research_summary: Current UK results prioritise immediate provider options, a definition of no-credit-check broadband, deal or postcode comparison, explanations of soft checks, social tariffs and prepaid alternatives. The sources conflict on some provider policies, notably NOW, so the page will identify reported options but require direct verification and will not promise approval. Ofcom supplies the strongest current affordability facts, Vodafone supplies a primary prepaid no-check example, and Experian supplies neutral definitions of search types.
depth_rationale: The three reviewed ranking pages range from about 1,400 to 2,500 editorial words, often with additional dynamic deal cards. A 1,600-word minimum is appropriate for this Guide because the search intent requires provider options, check types, social tariffs, prepaid alternatives, refusal steps, cost risks and FAQs. The target matches the useful explanatory depth of the rankings without reproducing long deal feeds or padding the page with generic credit-repair advice.
